newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Mobile Comms plans 5 pct buy-back.
newsitem.headline: Mobile Comms plans 5 pct buy-back.

text.p: Mobile Communications Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it planned to buy back up to five percent of its shares on-market over the next six months.
Mobile Communications Holdings Ltd owns five percent of Vodafone Australia.
Mobile Managing Director Philip Cornish said the company had a significant cash surplus and wanted to distribute that money to shareholders.
"We have analysed many other opportunities in the mobile sector, but to date none appear as attractive as our own shares," Cornish said in a statement.
In addition to its holding in Vodafone Australia, MBC has investments in mobile cellular billing companies in Europe and Australia.
Mobile floated in May 1996 at A$1.00 per share and its shares stood at A$2.50 at 10.50 a.m. (0050 GMT).
